# Praxis Innovations

> Software studio building mobile apps and online games. Based in Brampton, Ontario, Canada.

Praxis Innovations Inc. designs and builds consumer software products — mobile apps and browser-based games. Our current portfolio includes EvenX (expense splitting), Liar's Dice (online bluffing game), and PlaySequence (multiplayer Sequence card game).

## Company

- [Home](https://praxisinnovations.ca/): Company overview and mission
- [About](https://praxisinnovations.ca/about): Team and values
- [Services](https://praxisinnovations.ca/services): What we build and how we work
- [Portfolio](https://praxisinnovations.ca/portfolio): Product showcase — EvenX, Liar's Dice, PlaySequence
- [Contact](https://praxisinnovations.ca/contact): Get in touch

## Products

- [EvenX](https://evenx.io/): Expense splitting app for iOS and Android
- [Liar's Dice](https://liars-dice.app/): Free browser-based Liar's Dice game against AI
- [PlaySequence](https://playsequence.app/): Cross-platform multiplayer Sequence card game
